This match at Stade de France marks the NFL's first regular season game in Paris.
Both teams cross the Atlantic with contrasting form.
The Steelers come into this fixture with four wins and two losses this season.
Meanwhile, the Saints enter the match holding two wins and four losses so far.
Rolling Stone reports the over-80,000-seater venue is France's largest stadium, while Billboard says Burna Boy performs at halftime.
Bringing American football to Paris's biggest venue creates an unprecedented global stage for two historic franchises.
